pieces.Text: You have learned how to preserve a sample of oozes in a sealed bottle, which you can prepare for use as an extract.  When you activate the extract, you actually throw the bottle at a square within 30 feet, releasing the ooze, which reconstitutes and attacks the closest creature.  The ooze is not under your control, but is otherwise treated as a summoned creature.  The ooze remains for

rounds, and decays into powder when the duration expires.  If you have the infusion discovery, another character can use the infused specimen.  Creating a bottled ooze requires an extract with a level equal to the ooze's CR.
Bottled ooze discovery may only be used to bottle oozes which appear in the Pathfinder RPG Bestiary.
